head: 2a096303
method: source trace and in-memory D1 probes; no production calls or source edits

findings.title: Closed stores still serve public products and events
findings.impact: Private or suspended account catalog and event schedule remain available to unauthenticated callers who know the slug.

trace.detail: getAccountIdBySlug resolves any account slug, without public_enabled or status.
Public store profile requires public_enabled=1 and status=active.
Public products route uses the unrestricted slug resolver.
Public store events route uses the unrestricted slug resolver.

findings.reproduction: In local D1, seed an account with public_enabled=0 or status=suspended plus one public product and active event. GET /api/s/:slug returns 404; GET /api/s/:slug/products and /events both return 200 with content.
findings.smallestRemedy: Use getPublicAccountIdBySlug for both public child routes and add closure regression cases.

findings.title: Private events are discoverable and reveal their address
findings.impact: Unauthenticated discovery includes events explicitly marked private, and the public detail route returns address_text and venue context.

trace.detail: Public event detail selects address_text and venue_guide.
Detail query filters only active event status.
Public event discovery ignores public_visibility, network_discovery, and account status.
Public RSVP creation checks only event status.
Store event discovery checks only event status and account ID.

findings.reproduction: In local D1, seed a future active event with public_visibility=private, network_discovery=0, and address_text. GET /api/events and /api/s/:slug/events include it; GET /api/events/:slug/public returns its address.
findings.smallestRemedy: Define and apply shared public event visibility predicates for discovery, direct detail, and RSVP, including an active/public host account gate.

findings.title: Shop collections disclose hidden products and closed stores
findings.impact: Public collection discovery and link reads can disclose a product after it is made private or removed from the shop, and can continue exposing a closed store's collection.

trace.detail: Shop publication query has no host-account status/public gate.
Shop item query filters product status but not is_public or shown_in_shop.
Public collection link only checks publication and collection state.
Public link item projection filters only product status.

findings.reproduction: In local D1, seed private store, hidden active product (is_public=0, shown_in_shop=0), active collection and shop publication. GET /api/collections/shop and /api/public/c/:slug both return the product.
findings.smallestRemedy: Gate shop publications by open accounts and public, shown products; separately define whether recipient links may include private products.

findings.title: Incident intake trusts unverified tenant header
findings.impact: Any signed-in user can attribute an incident to another account; global signature dedupe can alter count, severity, and resolved state of an existing incident.

trace.detail: Handler uses requireAuth, which validates the session but does not authorize a tenant.
Handler passes raw X-Teajia-Account to upsertIncident.
Incident upsert merges by a global signature.

findings.reproduction: In local D1, user A belongs only to account A. POST /api/incidents with user A's JWT and X-Teajia-Account: account-b returned 201; the saved incident has account_id=account-b.
findings.smallestRemedy: Resolve account through live membership or store null for an untrusted global client report; review dedupe key tenancy.

concerns.title: OAuth scope fallback can mint immediately unusable tokens
concerns.impact: Viewer or restricted staff consent can fall back to write scopes they do not hold; live MCP authorization rejects the resulting token. No privilege escalation was found.

trace.detail: Default scopes include stock:write and sales:write.
Absent or fully filtered consent selection returns default scopes.
Live authority check rejects scopes exceeding current bundles.

concerns.validationNeeded: Focused OAuth decision/token test for a viewer and staff member without stock/sell bundles.
concerns.smallestRemedy: Intersect defaults and requested scopes with live bundle authority before minting.

coverage.limits: Targeted review of a large Worker; not every route or every MCP SQL statement was proven safe. No production-state inference.

tests.localProbes: SEC-01 through SEC-04 reproduced with bundled Worker and in-memory D1 using worker/schema.sql; temporary scripts were kept outside the repository.
tests.focusedExisting: mcp-live-authorization, inquiry-security, incidents: 55 passed; event-contract-routes: 81 passed
tests.limitations: Existing focused tests do not assert the reported privacy/tenant boundary cases. Initial test invocation accidentally included archived worktrees; clean rerun used standard worktree exclusions.

knownDebtDistinction: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md cites older audit/suspension gaps; current getActiveAccount blocks suspended accounts, so these were not counted without a fresh path-specific proof.
